note.en: HP and ATK stat recommendations differ for HP- and ATK-scaling DPS. HP-scaling DPS want [[character:sobin]] to have lots of SPD and more ATK than them to ensure CRIT DMG buffing. ATK-scaling DPS want full HP% Main Stats for more ATK buffing.
120+ SPD for ATK-scaling DPS. 160+/180+ SPD for HP-scaling DPS.
